name: Accordion rows
description: A stack of five filled bars 720 wide by 88 tall at 1440 (collapsed) in the surface tone with the dealt corner, 8px gaps, 28px side padding, left-aligned in a column opposite a headline or a picture. Each bar: a 22px medium title (a question or topic) of one line at the left and a typeset plus glyph at the right (no extra circle or button shape). Open one at a time: the bar grows over 320ms to reveal a two-to-three-line 17px answer of at most 30 words at 70% ink, the glyph turns to a cross and the bar takes the accent fill with its ink flipped. Colour roles: ground = the page ground, bars = the surface tone, ink = full ink, accent = the open bar. Each bar is a sibling card, never nested. Use it only for secondary detail such as the questions, never for the page's key content.

The panels arrive with the dealt entrance and sit with the dealt section gap above and below.

name: Code snippet panel

name: Corner-text render card

name: Portrait row, drifting photographs
description: Three portrait photographs across the content width, each about 416x560 (0.74), 32px gaps, the dealt corner, no text and no frame. name: Square photo pair, caption on photo
description: Two large square photographs side by side across the content width, each about 640x640 at 1440, 32px gap, the dealt corner, the right one starting 80px lower. Bottom-left on 32px padding: a title of up to two lines at the sub step, a one-line sentence at the body step in the ground colour and an underlined text link with a typeset arrow. signature: Two large square photographs, the right one 80px lower, each carrying a title, a sentence and an arrow link set directly on its calm dark lower-left.

name: List cards, three across
description: Three filled list cards across the content width, each about 300px tall, 32px gaps, the dealt corner, 32px padding. name: Framed video player

signature: One full-width 16:9 video in a 16px surface-tone mat with its title on the poster's calm lower-left and the dealt button reading Play at the centre; it plays in place with sound.

name: Video tile, large figure
description: A video tile 468 wide by 400 tall at 1440 (range 274-634 tall), in the dealt corner, filled edge to edge by a muted looping video that is abstract, rendered or product footage, dark at its left where the words sit. A heavy figure at the display step (about 72px) sits top-left, 28px in, and a 16px caption of up to three lines sits bottom-left at the same inset, both in the light ink. If the footage has no calm dark area there, a flat black scrim at 40-55% covers only the figure and caption blocks (never a gradient, never a wash over the whole video). The figure is a real measured claim (a speed, a percentage, a duration), never an index or a step number. One tile stands beside a text block, or two side by side with a 24px gap; never a cell in a grid of mixed tiles. The video plays while the tile is in view and pauses off-screen; hover slows it to half speed and nothing else moves.
signature: One 468x400 video tile with a 72px measured figure at its top-left and a caption at its bottom-left, standing beside a text block, never in a grid.
